name: RWC deferred sell burn removes pair RWC and syncs on demand
summary: RWC._transfer queues part of every sell as pendingPoolBurn, and the permissionless executePendingPoolBurn() later debits it from the PancakeSwap pair's own RWC balance and calls sync(), so the pool pays the burn. A flash-loan attacker looped buy, sell and burn to shrink the RWC reserve, ratchet the price and sell back for the pair's USDT.
notes: Non-proxy token; the owner's only later calls set fee and limit exemptions for team wallets, which the exploit did not need.
USDT routed to companyWallet and the deployer by the token's own sell-fee swap is counted: it left the pool only through the attacker's manipulated sells.
RWC burned from the pair has no market price after the attack; its realised value is the USDT drained, so it carries no separate USD value (rule 15).
